summary: In Step 1, I tapped the 'Log In' button marked in red on the initial welcome screen; the display transitioned to a new login page titled 'Welcome back!' which features input fields for 'Email address' and 'Password', a 'Forgot password?' link, a primary 'Log in' button, a 'Continue with Google' option, and a 'Sign up' link at the bottom. This new screen also displays a 'Skip' button in the top right corner and images of event settings, replacing the previous welcome illustration and navigation options.

In Step 2, I tapped the 'Email address' input field and typed '[REDACTED_TEST_SECRET]'; the field now displays 'c4a30e8aa799a8a1@example.com', and the on-screen keyboard is visible at the bottom of the screen. The rest of the 'Welcome back!' login interface, including the 'Password' field, 'Forgot password?' link, 'Log in' button, 'Continue with Google' button, and 'Sign up' link, remains unchanged on the screen.

In Step 3, I typed the password '[REDACTED_TEST_SECRET]' into the 'Password' field on the login screen. The field, which was previously empty, now displays a series of masked characters ending in '9'. The email address 'c4a30e8aa799a8a1@example.com' remains in the field above, and the 'Log in' button, 'Forgot password?' link, and 'Continue with Google' button are still visible on the screen, while the on-screen keyboard remains active at the bottom of the display.

In Step 4, I tapped the 'Done' button on the keyboard marked in red; the keyboard disappeared from the screen, and the 'Log in' button transitioned to a loading state displaying a blue circular spinner. The email address 'c4a30e8aa799a8a1@example.com' remains in the top field, and the password field is still populated with hidden characters. The 'Forgot password?', 'Continue with Google', and 'Sign up' links remain visible on the screen, and no other changes occurred to the layout of the login interface.

In Step 5, I waited for 5000ms while the login process was active on the 'Welcome back!' screen. Following this wait, the screen transitioned to the main application dashboard, which displays 'Hey EVIA E2E!' at the top, a balance of '200 coins', and a search bar. The main content area features a featured event titled '[DEMO] Workshop Flutter đang mở check-in' and a 'Recommended for You' section. At the bottom, a navigation bar is now visible with the 'Discover' tab currently selected, alongside 'Events', 'Rewards', and 'Profile' tabs.

In Step 6, I tapped the 'Events' tab located in the bottom navigation bar; the screen transitioned to the 'My Events' page, which displays 'Manage your registrations and passes' as a subtitle. The new view shows 'Upcoming 0' and 'Past 0' status indicators, a calendar strip for 'Nov 2 - Nov 8, 2026' with 'Today 6' highlighted, and a central message stating 'No events on this date' along with a 'Show all events' button.

In Step 7, I tapped the 'Rewards' tab icon marked in red on the bottom navigation bar; the screen transitioned to the 'Rewards' view, which displays a large header placeholder, two smaller content cards below it, and a title reading 'Rewards' at the top left. The bottom navigation bar remains visible, with the 'Rewards' icon now highlighted in blue and marked with a small dot, while the 'Discover', 'Events', and 'Profile' tabs remain accessible.

In Step 8, I tapped the 'Profile' tab marked in red on the bottom navigation bar; the screen transitioned to the 'Profile' page, which displays the user name 'EVIA E2E', ID 'SE990001', and email '[REDACTED_TEST_SECRET]'. The page includes an 'Edit Profile' button, a 'YOUR ACTIVITY' section with 'Saved Events', 'Following', and 'Notifications', and a 'PREFERENCES & SUPPORT' section containing 'My Interests', 'App Settings', and 'Help & Support'.
